brief:
Massive demonstrations swept cities worldwide today as activists raised flags and banners calling for an end to what organizers characterized as aggression against Palestine, Eye on Palestine reported. Participants across multiple locations pressed demands for justice as solidarity rallies drew crowds in coordinated action.

The protests occurred in cities on multiple continents, with demonstrators voicing unified calls for cessation of hostilities and accountability.
dek: Cities around the globe witnessed massive rallies today in solidarity with Palestine, with participants raising flags and banners demanding an end to the aggression and the pursuit of justice.
title: Global rallies demand end to aggression against Palestine
